name: The Vale of the Hollow
note: Hand-written. Coordinates are on a w x h parchment (1600 x 1000), bigger than the screen: the map scrolls. A location's map/spawn is where travelling there puts you; 'locked' ones show on the map but can't be reached yet; 'known' ones are on the map from the start, the rest appear once visited (or once a neighbour is visited, if 'seen' lists it). Wrenford, the new University town where a new game starts, lies far to the west on the river Wren. The river is the Hollow: it rises north of Corvanthe, runs through the Wound and the city, then south-west past Hollowmere. The Moriquende leads to Elfhome, where the forest year (js/forest.js) is played; Mother Agathe puts it on the map once you've graduated.

locations.name: Wrenford
locations.blurb: The new University town on the river Wren, founded by the scholars of Corvanthe who were away on the day. Nothing here is ruined. Everything here is careful.

locations.name: Hollowmere
locations.blurb: A river town half-emptied by the Unweaving. The west still stands; across the Hollow it is falling down.

locations.name: The Corvanthe Road
locations.blurb: The old cobbled road from Hollowmere to the walls of Corvanthe. Gleaners camp along it.

locations.name: Corvanthe
locations.blurb: The great university city, ruined in the Unweaving. Its citizens walk its streets still, as Echoes. The gleaners have cut a way in through the Wardgate, into Cindergate.

locations.name: The Moriquende
locations.blurb: The elf-wood at the end of the West Road, older than the University and older than Corvanthe. Elfhome is in its heart, and Sylvara is its Warden.
